synth.notes:
Frame colours define a 21x21 lattice of 3x3 tiles: background 9, axis 10, pieces 5, targets 11, reflections 4.
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece vertically; A3/A4 move pieces horizontally, blocked by board edges or other pieces.
A5 cycles the axis then pieces in descending size; reflections use row 2*axis-row and exclude occupied or off-board tiles.
Targets remain fixed; layered rendering preserves hole centres, and column 63 advances only on effective actions.
All 29 observed transitions pass with a stateless rule; clicks, undo, exhausted budget and fully hidden targets remain unconfirmed.
